head.title: Admission outcomes
head.subtitle: Import the official admission lists, match them to Zinapo children, and check whether the measurement predicts admission.

import.title: Import a list
import.sub: A CSV file of the official list (comma or semicolon separated, the first row is the header).
import.privacy: PINFLs are matched inside the service and never shown or stored — only the date of birth they contain. The file is read in your browser and reaches the server only when you send it.
import.noRows: The file has no rows after the header.
import.readFailed: Could not read the file. Choose it again.
import.discarded: The file's text was cleared from the page as soon as it was sent.

reasons.PINFL_INVALID: the PINFL is not 14 digits or its date of birth is not valid
reasons.ADMITTED_INVALID: admitted is not yes or no
reasons.YEAR_INVALID: year is not a valid year
reasons.DUPLICATE_CHILD_YEAR: this child already has an outcome for that year
reasons.other: the line could not be read

summary.title: Does the measurement predict admission?
summary.sub: Matched children by their last band in the current run. Counts only — no child is named.
summary.noneNote: "No band" — grades 0–2, children in cohorts under 30, or children never measured.
summary.emptyBody: In July, import the official admission list with the form above — the outcomes appear here after that.

review.title: Review queue
review.sub: Rows that did not match on their own. The name and date of birth come from the official list; a child can be linked only if the date of birth is the same.
review.emptyBody: Every row is matched or decided. Unmatched rows of a new list appear here after it is imported.
review.candidatesTitle: Candidates — same date of birth, similar family name
review.noCandidates: No Zinapo child has this date of birth and a similar family name.
review.matchBodyFmt: {row} will be linked to {child}, and the outcome is written as that child's admission outcome. This can't be undone later.
review.notTitle: Mark as not a Zinapo child?
review.notBodyFmt: {row} won't be linked to any Zinapo child and leaves the queue. This can't be undone later.
review.notDoneFmt: {row} marked as not a Zinapo child.

errors.CSV_EMPTY: The file is empty — it has not even a header row.
errors.CSV_COLUMNS: The file is missing required columns: {missing}. Check the header row.
errors.CSV_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large: at most {max} rows and 20 MB per import. Split it.
errors.DOB_MISMATCH: This child's date of birth doesn't match the one on the list, so they can't be linked.
errors.ALREADY_REVIEWED: Someone has already reviewed this row. The queue has been refreshed.
errors.CHILD_ALREADY_HAS_OUTCOME: This child already has an admission outcome for that year.
errors.CHILD_NOT_FOUND: This child can no longer be found. Load the candidates again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This row no longer exists. The queue has been refreshed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot import admission outcomes.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Check the network and try again.

states.noAccessBody: Importing admission lists belongs to the outcomes operator. If you need it, ask a super admin for that role.
states.errTitle: Could not load the admission outcomes
states.errBody: The server did not answer. The imported lists are safe — try again in a moment.
